answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 25434 Country: India Title: I wanna know that I can I use highlighter on the Quran. Question: Hi Saalam alekum I wanna know that I can I use highlighter on the Quran. Thank you Answer ID: 25434 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2361/H=813/th=1431) Doing so is lawful in itself. However, if there is any external evil and harm, then the matter would be different. However, it is better to show its sample to the local Ulama and use it after their confirmation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
